resources.body: Before travelling, confirm the department, appointment status, location and arrival instructions directly with the hospital. Requirements can differ between outpatient visits, admissions and diagnostic appointments.
steps: Confirm the department and location
Check the appointment time with the hospital
Bring only the documents the hospital requests
resources.title: Preparing for a hospital visit
resources.summary: A practical checklist for finding the right department, confirming visit details and preparing the documents requested by the hospital.

resources.body: A hospital may organise services by specialty, patient group or care setting. Use the department information as a starting point and contact the hospital if you are unsure where to direct an administrative enquiry.
steps: Read the department description
Check which location provides the service
Ask the hospital to confirm the correct contact route
resources.title: Finding the right hospital department
resources.summary: Understand how department directories, specialty pages and contact routes can help you reach the right team.

resources.body: Write down the practical questions you want to discuss and bring them to the appointment. A website cannot assess your personal situation or replace a conversation with a qualified professional.
steps: Ask who will be responsible for your visit
Ask what documents or follow-up steps are needed
Ask whom to contact after the appointment
resources.title: Questions to ask your care team
resources.summary: A simple way to prepare questions about a planned visit without relying on online information for a diagnosis.

resources.body: Admission processes vary by hospital, service and individual circumstances. Use the hospital's current admission guide and confirm required documents, arrival times and billing arrangements with staff.
steps: Confirm the admission date and location
Ask which documents are required
Confirm visitor and billing information
resources.title: Understanding hospital admission steps
resources.summary: Learn what administrative details to confirm before a planned admission.

resources.body: Visiting arrangements can vary by ward, patient needs and current hospital policy. Check the latest visiting information before travelling and follow staff instructions while on site.
steps: Check current visiting hours
Confirm visitor limits and access arrangements
Use the hospital's patient support contact for questions
resources.title: Planning a visit with a patient
resources.summary: Practical considerations for visitors, caregivers and family members.

resources.body: Published prices may not represent the final amount for an individual service. Ask the hospital to explain what an estimate includes, what may be charged separately and how insurance or coverage is verified.
steps: Request a written estimate where available
Ask what is included or excluded
Confirm coverage directly with the insurer and hospital
resources.title: Understanding hospital fees and estimates
resources.summary: How to ask for clear information about charges, estimates and payment arrangements.

resources.body: Use approved contact channels and avoid sending medical records, test results or detailed health histories through general website forms. The hospital should publish its privacy notice and a dedicated route for sensitive information.
steps: Read the current privacy notice
Share only necessary contact details
Use a verified secure channel for sensitive records
resources.title: Protecting your privacy when contacting a hospital
resources.summary: Understand why general enquiry forms should collect only the information needed to respond.

resources.body: Accessibility needs differ between people and facilities. Contact the hospital ahead of time to confirm available access routes, assistance and communication options.
steps: Ask about step-free access and parking
Request communication support if needed
Confirm the correct entrance and arrival point
resources.title: Planning an accessible hospital visit
resources.summary: Find out how to ask about access, communication and support arrangements before arrival.

resources.body: Preparation requirements vary by test and by laboratory. Do not rely on general online advice for fasting, medication changes or specimen collection; follow the specific instructions confirmed by the laboratory or your healthcare professional.
steps: Confirm the exact test and location
Read the laboratory's test-specific instructions
Contact the centre if any instruction is unclear
resources.title: Preparing for a diagnostic visit
resources.summary: A checklist for confirming test details, location and preparation instructions before travelling.

resources.body: Different tests can have different preparation, timing and specimen requirements. The test directory is an information aid, not a substitute for the laboratory's current instructions.
steps: Check the instructions for the exact test name
Confirm timing and collection requirements
Ask the laboratory before making changes to routine medication
resources.title: How to use test preparation instructions
resources.summary: Understand why test-specific guidance matters and where to ask for clarification.

resources.body: Laboratories may use different collection methods and operating hours. Confirm whether a sample is collected at the centre, at home or through another approved process before making arrangements.
steps: Confirm the collection location
Ask about appointment and operating hours
Follow the laboratory's specimen handling instructions
resources.title: Understanding sample collection
resources.summary: Learn what to confirm about collection methods, timing and location.

resources.body: Report delivery methods and release times are set by the laboratory. This template does not provide a live patient report portal unless the operator configures a separate secure system.
steps: Keep the reference supplied by the centre
Use the official report support channel
Do not share report links or credentials with others
resources.title: Accessing diagnostic reports
resources.summary: Find the right way to ask about report delivery and report access support.

resources.body: Package names alone do not explain every included service. Confirm the current price, included tests, exclusions and any additional charges with the diagnostic centre.
steps: Check the exact package inclusions
Ask whether collection or reporting fees are separate
Confirm the price before visiting
resources.title: Understanding test prices and packages
resources.summary: Questions to ask when comparing test prices and screening package inclusions.

resources.body: Not every location offers every test or collection service. Check the selected branch's service list, operating hours and contact information before travelling.
steps: Check the branch address and opening hours
Confirm the service is available there
Ask about accessibility and parking
resources.title: Choosing a diagnostic location
resources.summary: Compare published location details and confirm which services are available at each branch.

resources.body: A general appointment request should not collect medical history, diagnosis or test results. Use the laboratory's approved secure process for any sensitive information it needs to handle.
steps: Read the laboratory's privacy notice
Share only the details needed for a reply
Use an approved secure channel for reports
resources.title: Keeping diagnostic enquiries private
resources.summary: Understand how to share contact details safely when asking about a test.

resources.body: Group screening arrangements depend on the centre's capacity and the needs of the organisation. A request is an enquiry only; the provider must confirm scope, price and availability.
steps: Estimate group size and preferred dates
Ask which services can be delivered on site
Request a written scope and price
resources.title: Arranging workplace or group screening
resources.summary: Plan an initial conversation about group requirements, locations and scheduling.

resources.body: Before a specialist visit, confirm the clinic location, provider name, appointment time and any referral requirements. Personal clinical questions should be discussed with the qualified provider.
steps: Confirm the provider and clinic location
Check whether a referral is required
Bring only documents requested by the clinic
resources.title: Preparing for a specialist visit
resources.summary: A practical guide to confirming the clinic, provider, appointment details and documents requested.

resources.body: A short written list can help you remember the topics you want to discuss. The clinic website cannot assess your individual condition or recommend a treatment plan.
steps: Write down the questions you want to ask
Ask who to contact after the visit
Confirm any follow-up arrangements with the provider
resources.title: Preparing questions for a consultation
resources.summary: Organise the questions you want to raise with a specialist during your visit.

resources.body: Follow-up needs and schedules are determined by the treating professional. Use the clinic's published administrative contact route to ask how a follow-up appointment is requested.
steps: Check the follow-up instructions given by the clinic
Confirm the correct provider and location
Contact the clinic to request a suitable time
resources.title: Understanding follow-up appointments
resources.summary: Learn how to ask the clinic about follow-up timing and appointment changes.

resources.body: Fees can differ by provider, visit type and service. Confirm the current amount and any additional charges with the clinic before travelling.
steps: Ask for the current consultation fee
Confirm whether follow-up visits are priced differently
Check payment and insurance arrangements directly
resources.title: Asking about consultation fees
resources.summary: What to confirm about consultation charges, follow-up fees and payment options.

resources.body: Referral requirements vary by specialty and provider. The clinic should publish the current requirements and explain how a referring professional can send information securely.
steps: Confirm whether a referral is required
Ask which documents the clinic needs
Use the approved secure referral route
resources.title: Preparing referral information
resources.summary: Understand how to check whether a referral or supporting document is needed.

resources.body: A submitted appointment request is not a confirmed booking. For an existing confirmed appointment, contact the clinic using its verified channel and follow the published cancellation policy.
steps: Check the clinic's notice period
Use the official contact route
Wait for confirmation of the change
resources.title: Changing or cancelling a clinic appointment
resources.summary: Find out how to request a change and what cancellation rules to confirm.

resources.body: General forms should collect only the contact and scheduling information needed to respond. Do not include symptoms, diagnosis, medication details or medical records unless the clinic directs you to a separate approved system.
steps: Read the clinic privacy notice
Avoid entering sensitive clinical details in general forms
Use approved channels for medical records
resources.title: Privacy when using clinic forms
resources.summary: Understand what information a general clinic enquiry should and should not collect.

resources.body: Facilities and support options vary by location. Contact the clinic to confirm entrance access, mobility arrangements and any communication support you may need.
steps: Confirm the clinic entrance and floor
Ask about mobility access
Request communication support in advance
resources.title: Checking accessibility before a clinic visit
resources.summary: Ask about access and communication arrangements before travelling to a clinic.

resources.body: Remote consultation options depend on the provider's approved technology and service scope. A request form does not start a video call or confirm that a remote appointment is available.
steps: Wait for the provider to confirm the channel
Check the device and connection requirements
Use the contact route supplied by the provider if you need help
resources.title: Preparing for a remote consultation
resources.summary: A practical checklist for checking the consultation channel, device and appointment confirmation.

resources.body: The provider should publish supported devices, browser requirements and technical support routes. This template does not initiate a live video consultation unless a separate service is configured.
steps: Confirm the supported browser or app
Check camera and microphone permissions if required
Find the provider's technical support contact
resources.title: Checking your device and connection
resources.summary: Understand the basic technical details to confirm before a remote session.

resources.body: A private, quiet space can help you communicate with the provider. If you cannot use video or need another format, ask the provider about an accessible alternative before the appointment.
steps: Choose a space where you can speak privately
Check lighting and sound
Ask about alternative formats if needed
resources.title: Choosing a suitable space for a remote conversation
resources.summary: Consider privacy, sound and accessibility when preparing for a remote appointment.

resources.body: The care team must review the request and confirm eligibility, availability and the consultation channel. A submitted form is not an appointment confirmation and should not be used for urgent care.
steps: Keep the request reference if one is supplied
Wait for direct confirmation
Contact support if the response timeframe has passed
resources.title: What happens after a consultation request
resources.summary: Understand the steps between submitting contact details and receiving provider confirmation.

resources.body: Digital health services should explain what information they collect, why they need it and which approved systems handle sensitive records. Do not send medical documents through a general contact form.
steps: Read the provider's privacy notice
Use only approved secure communication channels
Ask how to request access or correction
resources.title: Privacy when using digital health services
resources.summary: Questions to ask about data collection, communication channels and patient information security.

resources.body: Digital services should explain available accessibility features and provide a support route when a standard video or audio channel is not suitable.
steps: Ask which accessibility features are supported
Request an alternative communication method
Contact support before the scheduled session
resources.title: Making remote care more accessible
resources.summary: Find out how to request captions, alternative communication or technical assistance.

resources.body: Changes must be confirmed by the provider. Do not assume that changing a form submission updates an existing booking or that a new request cancels an earlier appointment.
steps: Use the provider's official contact channel
Include the appointment reference if supplied
Wait for confirmation of the new arrangement
resources.title: Changing a remote appointment
resources.summary: Understand how to contact the provider about a confirmed remote appointment.

resources.body: Remote consultation requests are not emergency triage and may not be monitored continuously. If someone may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services rather than waiting for an online response.
steps: Do not use general forms for emergencies
Contact local emergency services for immediate danger
Use the provider's verified contact route for non-urgent support
resources.title: When a remote request is not appropriate
resources.summary: Know the limits of a website request form and where to seek urgent help.
